title: Buyer Beware: These 2 Stocks Charts Just Displayed a Death Cross
body: Technical analysis shows death crosses emerging for Hertz Global Holdings and Kinross Gold, signaling potential further downside. Hertz faces dilution concerns, depreciation pressure, and slashed profit guidance, while Kinross struggles as gold prices tumble amid dollar strength and inflation concerns. Both stocks exhibit deteriorating fundamentals and negative investor sentiment.

title: Kinross releases 2025 Sustainability Report
body: Kinross Gold Corporation released its 2025 Sustainability Report highlighting $4.9 billion in economic contributions to host countries, improved safety records, increased female workforce representation to 15%, and a 2.4% reduction in GHG emissions intensity. The company maintained top-10 rankings in sustainability assessments and achieved a 33-year record of zero tailings breaches.

title: 8 Lagging Stocks Flashing Rebound Signals Near Their 200-Day Moving Averages
body: Despite US stock indices reaching record highs, some stocks have fallen 10-18% over the past month due to market volatility and sector rotations. The article identifies 8 beaten-down stocks trading near their 200-day moving averages with strong fundamentals and positive analyst sentiment, suggesting potential rebound opportunities. Two highlighted examples are Kinross Gold with strong Q1 results and cash flow, and US Foods with consistent market share gains.

title: Newmont Transaction Highlights Rising Valuations For Undeveloped Gold Assets
body: Senior gold producers are reporting record financial metrics as realized gold prices reach $4,800-$4,900/oz, up from $1,800/oz in 2022. This repricing is revaluing undeveloped gold assets significantly. Greenland Mines' Skaergaard Project shows 45-55% grade uplift in sensitivity analysis under higher price scenarios. Major producers including Newmont, Barrick, Agnico Eagle, and Kinross are unlocking value through restructurings and asset repricings.

title: Greenland Mines Just Reported PdEq Grades Up 45-55% in MetalPrice Sensitivity Work at One of the World's Largest Undeveloped Pd-Au-Pt Deposits
body: Greenland Mines Ltd. announced results of an independent metal-price sensitivity analysis on its Skaergaard Project in Greenland, showing palladium-equivalent (PdEq) grade increases of 45% for Indicated and 55% for Inferred resources under higher gold price assumptions ($5,000/oz Au vs. $1,800/oz in 2022 base case). title: Kinross announces Annual Shareholder Meeting voting results
body: Kinross Gold Corporation held its Annual Meeting of Shareholders on April 30, 2026, successfully electing all 10 nominated directors with strong shareholder support (96-99.91% votes for). The company reported record free cash flow for the fourth consecutive quarter and returned approximately $350 million to shareholders in 2026, with a declared dividend of US$0.04 per share.

title: Kinross declares quarterly dividend
body: Kinross Gold Corporation announced a quarterly dividend of US$0.04 per common share payable on June 4, 2026. The dividend qualifies as an eligible dividend for Canadian tax purposes. The company reported strong first-quarter 2026 results with record free cash flow for the fourth consecutive quarter and returned approximately $350 million to shareholders year-to-date.

title: Ninepoint Partners Announces Anticipated Monthly Cash Distributions for its new Canadian stock HighShares and CoreShares ETFs
body: Ninepoint Partners LP launched new Canadian single-stock HighShares and CoreShares ETFs, announcing anticipated initial monthly distributions to be paid on May 7, 2026. The ETFs track companies including Constellation Software, Celestica, and Kinross Gold with monthly distribution amounts ranging from $0.04 to $0.21 per share.

title: Kinross recommends shareholders reject TRC Capital Investment’s below-market “mini-tender” offer for common shares
body: Kinross Gold Corporation strongly recommends shareholders reject an unsolicited mini-tender offer from TRC Capital Investment Corporation to purchase 2.5 million shares at C$41.75 per share, which is approximately 4.4% below the market price of C$43.68. Kinross warns that mini-tender offers are designed to avoid regulatory disclosure requirements and cautions investors to compare offer prices with current market prices.

title: Kinross to announce Q1 results on April 29, 2026
body: Kinross Gold Corporation announced that it will release its Q1 2026 financial results on April 29, 2026, followed by a conference call on April 30, 2026. The company will also hold its Annual Meeting of Shareholders virtually on April 30, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. EDT. Meeting materials and voting instructions are now available to shareholders.

title: Kinross announces renewal of NCIB
body: Kinross Gold Corporation has received TSX approval to renew its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) program, authorizing the repurchase of up to 104.2 million common shares (10% of public float) through March 23, 2027. The company plans to use this program alongside its quarterly dividend to enhance shareholder returns, supported by its investment-grade balance sheet and strong free cash flow generation.

title: 10 Beaten-Down Gold Stocks With Up to 83% Rebound Potential
body: Gold prices have fallen below $5,000 despite geopolitical tensions, as investors sell the metal to cover losses in declining stock markets and the strengthening US dollar makes it more expensive globally. However, analysts view this weakness as a buying opportunity for gold stocks, which have plunged 16.6-27.3% over two weeks but could rebound 31.9-83.3% if gold resumes its upward trend. Central bank buying and inflation concerns remain supportive factors.

title: Ninepoint Files Preliminary Prospectus for Nine New Single-Stock ETFs
body: Ninepoint Partners has filed a preliminary prospectus for nine new single-stock ETFs, expanding its HighShares lineup to include U.S. companies like NVIDIA, Tesla, Alphabet, and Intel, alongside Canadian stocks. The firm is also introducing CoreShares ETFs with a competitive 0.29% management fee and monthly income distributions.

title: Kinross Increases Ownership in Eminent to 13.8% and Files Early Warning Report
body: Kinross Gold Corporation has exercised 3,787,118 common share purchase warrants in Eminent Gold Corp., increasing its ownership stake to 13.8% on a non-diluted basis. The warrant exercise generated C$2,650,983 in gross proceeds for Eminent, which plans to use the funds to resume drilling at its Hot Springs Range Project and advance its Celts project. Kinross also received additional incentive warrants as part of the transaction.

title: Kinross announces 14% annual increase to cash dividend and declares Q4 dividend
body: Kinross Gold Corporation's Board of Directors has approved a 14% increase to its dividend, bringing the annualized dividend to $0.16 per share. This follows a previous increase announced in November 2025, representing a cumulative 33% increase since Q3 2025. The company also approved a quarterly dividend of $0.04 per share payable on March 26, 2026.

title: Precious Metals in Focus: Gold Strength, Mining Leaders, and Cyclical Plays
body: Gold prices have surged with tight physical supply, making mining stocks more attractive than physical gold. The article highlights several precious metals companies as strong investment opportunities, including Hecla Mining, First Majestic Silver, Alamos Gold, Kinross Gold, and Eldorado Gold. CF Industries is also discussed as a cyclical fertilizer play benefiting from strong farming demand.

title: Which Mining Firms Are Striking It Rich in the Metals Rally?
body: Despite gold falling over $600 from its January peak of $5,600/oz following Kevin Warsh's Fed nomination, precious metals remain attractive to investors in 2026. Gold mining stocks have surged 147% in the past year. Three standout companies are highlighted: Hecla Mining (dual gold/silver focus with 300% gains), Coeur Mining (pursuing M&A strategy with New Gold acquisition), and Kinross Gold (record free cash flow of $687M in Q3 2025 with 185% annual gains).

title: Nova Minerals Plans to Redomicile to the United States and Seeks 100% Ownership of the Estelle Project
body: Nova Minerals announced plans to redomicile from Australia to the United States by end of June 2026 following loss of foreign private issuer status due to majority U.S. ownership. The company will pursue acquisition of the remaining 15% stake in its Estelle Gold and Critical Minerals Project in Alaska to achieve 100% ownership, and is searching for a U.S.-based CFO with mining and GAAP accounting experience as current CFO Michael Melamed resigns effective April 30, 2026.

title: Eminent Appoints Ivan Bebek as Strategic Advisor for Corporate Development and Finance
body: Eminent Gold Corp. announced the appointment of Ivan Bebek as Strategic Advisor for Corporate Development and Finance. Bebek brings over 25 years of junior mining experience, including successful discoveries and M&A transactions. He will support Eminent's Hot Springs Range gold discovery in Nevada, which has attracted investment from Kinross Gold.

title: Kinross to provide update on Round Mountain Phase X, Kettle River-Curlew and Bald Mountain Redbird 2 projects
body: Kinross Gold Corporation will provide an update on three major projects (Round Mountain Phase X, Kettle River-Curlew, and Bald Mountain Redbird 2) during a virtual presentation on January 15, 2026. The company also recently received a Baa2 rating upgrade from Moody's and announced a $500 million redemption of Senior Notes.

title: Kinross upgraded to Baa2 Rating by Moody’s
body: Kinross Gold Corporation was upgraded by Moody's from Baa3 to Baa2, with a stable outlook, due to its strong financial position, low leverage, and consistent debt repayment strategy. The company repaid $700 million in debt in 2025 and maintains a net cash position of approximately $500 million.

title: Elliot Management Takes Stake In Barrick Mining — Stock Climbs
body: Activist hedge fund Elliott Management acquired a substantial stake in Barrick Mining, potentially driving a strategic business split focusing on higher-growth North American mining operations.

title: S&P 500’s Top Stock Lifts Dividend 25% as Peers Boost Payouts
body: Several S&P 500 stocks have announced significant dividend increases in 2025, with Western Digital, Kinross Gold, and Marathon Petroleum delivering impressive total returns and boosting shareholder payouts.

title: Kinross announces 17% annual increase to cash dividend and declares Q3 dividend
body: Kinross Gold Corporation announced a 17% increase in its annual dividend to $0.14 per share, with a quarterly dividend of $0.035 per common share payable on December 10, 2025.

title: Kinross to redeem $500 million in Senior Notes on December 4, 2025
body: Kinross Gold Corporation will redeem all outstanding 4.50% Senior Notes due July 15, 2027, with an aggregate principal amount of $500 million, on December 4, 2025.

title: Matachewan Provides Corporate Update
body: Matachewan Consolidated Mines sold 91,530 common shares of Kinross Gold Corporation between March and August 2025, generating $2,049,194 in proceeds with shareholder consent.

title: AbraSilver Announces $43.4 Million “Bought Deal” Life Private Placement to Advance Diablillos Project
body: AbraSilver Resource Corp. has secured a $43.4 million 'bought deal' private placement to advance its Diablillos silver-gold project in Argentina, with funds to be used for early development expenditures and infrastructure.

title: Montero Secures Option to Acquire Highly Prospective Gold Projects in Chile's Maricunga Belt
body: Montero Mining and Exploration has secured option agreements to acquire 100% interest in two gold projects (Elvira and Potrero) in Chile's Maricunga Belt, with staged payments totaling US$7 million per project over six years.

title: Gold Miners Remain Undervalued Despite Stellar Rally: Expert Says They Are Set To Post 'Highest Profit Margins' In History
body: Gold mining stocks have seen impressive gains year-to-date, with experts predicting unprecedented profit margins due to rising gold prices and favorable macroeconomic conditions. Despite significant share price increases, the sector remains undervalued with contracting Price-to-Earnings ratios.

title: Contango Announces Production of 17,000 ounces of Gold and $33 Million Cash Distribution from Campaign 3-2025 from the Peak Gold JV
body: Contango ORE reported producing 17,000 ounces of gold in its third 2025 campaign and received a $33 million cash distribution from the Peak Gold Joint Venture. The company aims to triple its annual gold production to 200,000 ounces over the next five years through internal funding and development of its Lucky Shot and Johnson Tract projects.

title: Kinross to announce Q3 results on November 4, 2025
body: Kinross Gold Corporation will release its third quarter 2025 financial statements on November 4, 2025, after market close, followed by a conference call and webcast on November 5, 2025 at 8:00 a.m. ET.

title: The 5 Best Gold Mining Stocks to Buy Now
body: With gold prices reaching $3,800 per ounce, gold mining stocks offer leveraged exposure to the precious metal's rally. Five top mining stocks are highlighted, offering opportunities for investors seeking growth and dividend income in the gold sector.

title: Eminent Resumes Drilling on Its Emerging Gold Discovery in Nevada
body: Eminent Gold Corp has resumed core drilling at its Hot Springs Range Project in Nevada, focusing on the Otis target after successful initial drilling that discovered gold mineralization. The program is supported by Kinross Gold's strategic investment and aims to further explore potential gold deposits.

title: GOLD ROYALTY REACHES MILESTONE 250TH ASSET AND PROVIDES AN UPDATE ON SELECTED PORTFOLIO ASSETS
body: Gold Royalty Corp. announced reaching its 250th asset through its royalty generator model, highlighting growth from 18 royalties in 2021 to 250 today. The company provided updates on several portfolio assets, including positive developments in gold and silver mining projects.

title: CONTANGO PROVIDES UPDATE ON FINANACING AND EXPLORATION PLANS
body: Contango Ore announced a $50 million financing to advance exploration at its Lucky Shot and Johnson Tract gold properties, aiming to increase annual gold production from 60,000 to 200,000 ounces.

title: CONTANGO ORE CLOSES $50 MILLION UNDERWRITTEN PUBLIC OFFERING OF COMMON STOCK AND PRE-FUNDED WARRANTS
body: Contango Ore completed a $50 million public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants, with plans to fund exploration and development of its Lucky Shot and Johnson Tract mining projects in Alaska.

title: The Dollar Is Sliding--Here's How Wall Street Is Positioning Now
body: Gold reached record highs in September 2025, driven by a weaker U.S. dollar and strong central-bank demand. Goldman Sachs projects gold could climb to $3,700 by year-end and potentially reach $4,500 per ounce if investors shift from dollar assets to bullion.

title: Kinross Sells Portion of Asante Gold Position
body: Kinross Gold Corporation sold 36,927,650 common shares of Asante Gold Corporation, representing 5.2% of outstanding shares, at C$1.98 per share for a total of C$73,116,747. After the sale, Kinross remains an investor through convertible instruments.

title: Copper Quest Acquires the Nekash Copper-Gold Porphyry Project in Idaho, USA
body: Copper Quest Exploration Inc. has acquired the Nekash Copper-Gold Porphyry Project in Idaho, a 585-hectare property with promising copper-gold mineralization potential, and appointed Joshua White as Technical Advisor.

title: Asante Announces Listing on TSX Venture Exchange
body: Asante Gold Corporation will commence trading on the TSX Venture Exchange on September 24, 2025, and will voluntarily delist from the Canadian Securities Exchange. The company will continue trading under its current ticker symbol and expects increased investor visibility.

title: Contango Announces Inclusion into the Global Junior Gold Miners Index (GDXJ)
body: Contango Ore has been included in the Global Junior Gold Miners Index (GDXJ) for the 3rd quarter of 2025, marking a significant milestone for the company's growth strategy in gold exploration and production.

title: Gold Miners Cut Direct Emissions, But ESG Intensity Worsens, Report
body: Global gold producers reduced combined greenhouse-gas emissions to under 30 million tons in 2024, but emissions intensity worsened due to lower ore grades. Safety performance declined with fatalities increasing, while renewable energy adoption remains limited.

title: Asante Announces Partial Sale of Position Held by Kinross
body: Kinross Gold Corporation sold 29,850,984 common shares of Asante Gold, representing 4.2% of outstanding shares, at $1.55 per share with a 10% discount. After the sale, Kinross retains approximately 5.2% of Asante's outstanding shares.

title: Aurion Announces Kinross Agreement to Purchase Additional Units in Aurion to Maintain Ownership Position
body: Aurion Resources announced a non-brokered private placement with Kinross Gold Corporation to maintain Kinross's 9.99% ownership position. The placement involves 885,000 units at C$0.84 per unit, raising C$743,400 for exploration of the Risti Project in Finland.

title: Critical Metals Corp Announces the Creation of an Advisory Board
body: Critical Metals Corp announced the formation of an Advisory Board with two experienced professionals, Christian Aramayo and Mathew August, to support the company's strategic development of critical mineral projects in Greenland and Europe.

title: Kinross declares quarterly dividend
body: Kinross Gold Corporation announced a quarterly dividend of US$0.03 per common share, payable on September 4, 2025, to shareholders of record as of August 21, 2025.

title: Kinross announces sale of shares of White Gold
body: Kinross Gold Corporation has sold its entire 12% stake in White Gold Corp., representing 23,681,160 common shares at an average price of $0.29 per share, totaling $6,869,905.51.

title: Liberty Gold Strengthens Development Team to Advance Black Pine Through Feasibility and Permitting
body: Liberty Gold strengthens its technical team by appointing four experienced mining professionals to advance the Black Pine Oxide Gold Project in Idaho, focusing on feasibility engineering and permitting.

title: Eminent Initiates Gravity Survey at HSRP to Enhance Drill Targeting
body: Eminent Gold Corp has launched a high-resolution gravity geophysical survey at its Hot Springs Range Project in Nevada, aiming to improve drill targeting and explore potential gold mineralization, in collaboration with Kinross Gold Corporation.

title: Kinross releases 2024 Sustainability Report
body: Kinross Gold Corporation has published its 2024 Sustainability Report, highlighting its strong performance in areas such as workforce and community, natural capital, and climate and energy. The report details the company's commitment to responsible mining and its positive economic impact, including $4 billion in total benefits to host countries.
